blocks.text: Is mein study area ko ek grid (jaali) mein baanta jata hai aur be-tarteeb (random) chune hue chaukoron (quadrats) ke andar sample liya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa khaas taur par podon ki aabadi ya ek jagah jure rehne wale (sessile) jandaron ke liye mufeed hai. Misal: jungle mein researcher ek muqarrar size ke quadrats bichha kar har quadrat mein har plant species ki maujoodgi ya ghair maujoodgi likhta hai.

Is mein study area ke aar paar ek line ya patti (transect) bichhai jati hai aur is line ke saath baqaida faaslon par species note ki jati hain. Yeh tareeqa badalte mahol mein species ka phailao dekhne ke liye achha hai. Misal: saahil (coastal zone) par high tide line se low tide line tak transect bichha kar intertidal (jowar bhaate ke darmiyan wale) jandaron ki qismein aur tadaad note ki ja sakti hai.

Aerial surveys mein hawai jahaz (aircraft) ya drones se bare ilaqon mein jandaron ka phailao dekha aur note kiya jata hai. Misal: kisi bare wetland mein parindon ki species ka phailao dekhna, ya savanna (ghaas ke bare maidan) mein bare mammals ki aabadi par nazar rakhna.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. Quadrat Sampling: zameen ki ghaas par ek chaukor frame jo 25 chhote khanon mein bata hai. Transect Sampling: ek kaarkun podon wale maidan ke aar paar bichhi line ke paas baith kar line ke saath chaukor quadrat frame rakhta hai. Aerial Surveys: ek drone darakhton aur jheel wali zameen ke upar urta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Quadrat sampling mein ilaqe ko grid (jaali) mein baant kar sirf be-tarteebi se chune gaye khanon mein jandar gine jate hain. Transect sampling mein ek line (transect) gradient ke aar paar bichhai jati hai, jaise sahil par high tide line se low tide line tak, aur line ke saath barabar faaslon par record kiya jata hai. Aerial surveys mein hawai jahaz ya drone oopar se bare ilaqe ki tasveerein le kar jandaron ka phailao dekhte hain, jaise parindon ke jhund ya savanna ke bare janwar.

items: Point counts: ek muqarrar jagah se, muqarrar waqt tak, kisi species ke nazar aane wale afraad gin kar likhe jate hain. Yeh tareeqa aam taur par parindon aur harkat karne wale doosre janwaron ke liye hai.

Mark-recapture: kisi species ke afraad ko pakar kar, un par nishaan laga kar chhor diya jata hai; phir baad mein dobara pakar kar aabadi ka size aur density (ghanapan) ka andaza lagaya jata hai. Yeh un janwaron ke liye mufeed hai jinhein seedha ginna mushkil ho.
Quadrat counts: researchers har quadrat ke andar kisi species ke afraad ginte hain aur in ginti se poori aabadi (overall abundance) ka andaza lagate hain.
Capture-recapture methods: yeh models aisi baaton (variables) ka hisaab rakhte hain jaise har dafa pakre jaane ka alag imkaan (probability) aur janwaron ka ek ilaqe se doosre mein jaana.
Remote sensing: satellite ya drone ki tasveeron se species ki tadaad aur phailao jaancha jata hai, khaas kar bohat bare ya aise ilaqon mein jahan pahunchna mushkil ho.

blocks.title: Tareeqa chunna
blocks.problem: Ek student jaanna chahta hai ke talaab ke kinare se khushk dhalaan tak poday kaise badalte hain, aur alag se yeh ke talaab mein kitne mendak hain. Kaun se tareeqe munasib hain?
steps: Podon ka sawal ek gradient (geela se khushk) ke aar paar phailao ke bare mein hai, is liye talaab ke kinare se dhalaan tak transect, jis par baqaida faaslon par quadrats ya records hon, sahih intikhab hai.
Mendak harkat karte aur chhupte hain, is liye unhein seedha ginna mushkil hai. Mark-recapture un ki aabadi ka andaza deta hai.
blocks.answer: Podon ke liye transect sampling; mendakon ke liye mark-recapture.

items: Biodiversity zindagi ki variety hai: species, genes aur ecosystems.
Ecosystem: jandar aur un ka physical mahol (biotic aur abiotic factors). Niche: ecosystem mein ek species ka kirdar.
Biodiversity species, genetic aur ecosystem levels par jaanchi jati hai.
Random sampling bias kam karti hai, qabil-e-bharosa andaze deti hai, muqabla mumkin banati hai, sample ko poore ilaqe jaisa banati hai aur conservation mein madad deti hai.
Distribution: quadrat sampling, transect sampling, aerial surveys. Abundance: point counts, mark-recapture, quadrat counts, capture-recapture methods, remote sensing.

blocks.prompt: Biodiversity jaanchne ke teen darje batayein, aur phailao ka ek tareeqa aur tadaad ka ek tareeqa batayein, is ke saath ke har ek kis qisam ke jandar ke liye munasib hai.
blocks.explanation: Species, genetic aur ecosystem darje. Distribution: quadrat sampling podon aur sessile jandaron ke liye munasib hai (ya gradient ke liye transects, bare ilaqon ke liye aerial surveys). Abundance: point counts parindon aur harkat karne wale janwaron ke liye; mark-recapture un janwaron ke liye jinhein seedha ginna mushkil ho.
